title: Relay key request parameters information element

fields.name: Relay key request parameters IEI
fields.description: Information element identifier for relay key request parameters

fields.name: Length of Relay key request parameters
fields.description: Length of the relay key request parameters

fields.name: Relay service code
fields.description: 24-bit relay service code as defined in 3GPP TS 24.554 [19E]

fields.name: Nonce_1
fields.description: 128-bit nonce value as defined in 3GPP TS 24.554 [19E]

fields.name: Remote UE identity
fields.description: 5G ProSe remote UE identity which is coded as 5GS mobile identity IE starting from octet 2 with the Type of identity set to SUCI (see subclause 9.11.3.4)

notes: Whether other parameters are included is FFS and will be determined by SA3
